assumptions: F2, F5 and F8 are strategic flights and are intended to remain operated.
For this behavioral reference, cancellations are not used.
Only flight/aircraft/crew temporal non-overlap is enforced; no additional minimum turn or minimum connection time is assumed.
Among feasible no-cancellation schedules, use the minimum propagated delay needed to restore capacity and resource time feasibility.
expected_objective remains null until SRM/ARM/CRM/PRM cost coefficients are implemented.

capacity_oracle.reason_F2_is_reference_delayed_flight: F2 can move to 10:30 with a 50-minute delay; F5 and F8 have max_delay=20 and cannot leave the interval.

propagation_oracle.explanation: F2 delayed 50 min arrives C at 11:30; AC1 cannot operate F3 at its original 11:00 departure, so F3 needs at least 30 min delay.
C1 operates F2 then F10. Delayed F2 arrives C at 11:30, so F10 cannot depart at 11:10 and needs at least 20 min delay.
Recovered F3 and F10 both reach A at 12:30. F11 originally departs A at 12:20, so it needs at least 10 min delay.
